about: Error numbers that macOS has and Linux has not, and the error of the image that stands for each: the name of an error of Linux that a program takes the same way, or a number that bun has for it in the image (src/errno/windows_errno.rs, which is the enum of the image). host/host_posix.c has the same table for the requests it answers; tools/check-darwin.ts compares the two.
